_meta.purpose: Every phone number and legal line the app could show. Nothing here renders in a production build until someone has checked it against an official source and set verified to true.
_meta.rule: Abdelrahman owns this flag: CLAUDE.md says only he flips verified to true, after reading an official source. The three contacts below were flipped on 17 Sep on Zaid's 16 Sep reading as relayed in Abdelrahman's brief, which is his instruction but not his own reading — so it is called out here rather than left to look routine. Every verified entry carries value, source_url, verified_on and verified_by so any of it can be re-checked, or reverted, without repeating the work.
_meta.origin: The three contacts record Zaid's check against psd.gov.jo on 16 Sep 2026, written here on 17 Sep and attributed to him rather than presented as an independent check — the machine that wrote this file cannot reach psd.gov.jo, the egress proxy refuses it. That is the whole reason verified_by, verified_on and source_url exist on every row. .github/workflows/verify-sources.yml opens every URL in this file from somewhere that can, and fails if one is dead.

never_show.why: Not officially documented anywhere. It circulates as a Cybercrime Unit number and is not one. A test asserts it appears in no file.
The Jordan River Foundation's families-and-children helpline — a charity line, not the PSD directorate. This file carried it as Family Protection and was wrong.
Carried from v1. Matches no published PSD number.

contacts.dial_note_why: 196 and 812594 are never joined into one number — tel:196812594 dials nothing. extensions is a separate field for exactly this reason.

why_no_number.en: This directorate has no single national number — it publishes one per governorate.
why_no_number.ar: لا يوجد رقم وطني موحّد لهذه الإدارة؛ لكل محافظة رقم خاص بها.

when_to_call.en: Cases involving family, minors, or domestic violence.
when_to_call.ar: الحالات التي تخص الأسرة أو الأحداث أو العنف الأسري.

contacts.source_note: Zaid read the directorate's page on psd.gov.jo. The domain is recorded rather than the exact path, because this machine cannot open the site to confirm a path and a link that 404s in front of someone in trouble is worse than one more tap.
contacts.why_no_number_note: Do not 'fix' this by picking one governorate's number: showing any one of them as THE number sends most people to the wrong governorate. The app shows the directorate's own page instead, and routes immediate danger to 911.

text.en: Cybercrime Law No. 17 of 2023 protects you.
text.ar: قانون الجرائم الإلكترونية رقم 17 لسنة 2023 يحميك.

legal.note: A statement about the law. It needs the official text and the article cited before it renders. Not part of P0-2, which covered phone numbers only.

links.note: The authority for all three contacts, kept as the one record of the domain. What the Family Protection row actually opens is its own official_url; there was a second, identical entry here for it and it rendered nowhere.
